Out of Hypersleep · art direction · rev A

Used future

The direction: late-70s industrial sci-fi. Heavy hulls, CRT phosphor, stencilled labels, frost on steel. The ship and its tooling are old, scuffed and reliable. The alien AI is the only clean, glossy, modern thing on screen, so the contrast carries the story.

Deck 01

Palette

Hull#0b0d10Slide ground. Never pure black.
Plate#1e232bPanels, terminals, cards.
Ship amber#ffb547Ship UI: kickers, labels, hazard stripes.
Frost#cfefffCryo only. Pods, ice, cold light.
Phosphor#45e6a0Awake pods, terminal output, crew score.
Alien#ff3b5cThe alien only. Glossy, glowing, rare.

This replaces the neon navy and cyan. The current --cryo #7fe3ff becomes the softer frost; amber moves up from a warning colour to the ship's main UI colour.

Deck 04

House rules

Plates are backgrounds

Midjourney does atmosphere only. Pods, votes, HUD, ship map and code stay SVG so they animate and stay sharp.

Dark, quiet, one side empty

Every plate leaves a dark, low-detail third for text. Darken in post rather than fighting the prompt.

Red belongs to the alien

No red in ship plates. Dead pods use a dim red status light, nothing more.

Texture over effects

Film grain and faint scanlines on top of everything. No lens flares, no neon glow outside CRTs and the alien.

Deck 05

Midjourney prompt pack

  1. Make the master first. Run the hero prompt, reroll until one image nails the mood, upscale it.
  2. Lock the style. Copy that image's URL and replace HERO_URL in the suffix. Every other prompt reuses it via --sref.
  3. Upscale to 3200px+ (the canvas is 1600 wide), export as WebP, drop into presentation/public/plates/.
  4. Grade once. Same curves on every plate: crush blacks toward #0b0d10, pull saturation down 15–20%.
